gates.name: Apply
gates.happens: The role is chosen, consent to be vetted is captured under POPIA — specific, informed and revocable — and the documents are uploaded.
gates.failRule: No consent to vet, no processing. Nothing about a person is checked until they have agreed to be checked.
gates.statement: You choose the role and agree to be vetted. You can withdraw that agreement, and vetting stops when you do.
gates.why: No check in any role carries this gate, because the gate is the application itself: a party on the register is a party who applied. What the register does not yet hold is the consent as its own record — the preview asks for it on the application form, and the identity service does not store it against the party. That gap is written here rather than papered over with a check that would be verified by nobody.

gates.name: Identity
gates.happens: The identity number is validated against Home Affairs through an accredited provider, a live selfie is matched to the identity photograph, and a business owner is screened against sanctions lists.
gates.failRule: An identity that does not match is a hard stop. Nothing at a later gate is looked at, whatever it says.
gates.statement: Your identity is matched against Home Affairs through an accredited provider, before anything else about you is looked at.

gates.name: Credentials
gates.happens: Professional registration is checked at source, and every licence, permit, accreditation and schedule of cover is captured with its expiry date.
gates.failRule: A registration, licence or cover that is not current is a hold until it is renewed. Nothing is offered in the meantime.
gates.statement: Your registration, licences and cover are checked with the body that issued them, and their renewal dates are watched from then on.

gates.name: Background
gates.happens: A SAPS criminal record clearance, the National Register for Sex Offenders, the Child Protection Register, an adverse-media search and two references contacted directly.
gates.failRule: A listing on the National Register for Sex Offenders or the Child Protection Register is a permanent bar, and so is a violent, sexual or fraud conviction. Any other finding goes to a review panel, never to one reviewer.
gates.statement: Your police clearance and your references are checked. Referees are contacted directly, never through you.
gates.gap: The master document requires the National Register for Sex Offenders and the Child Protection Register as checks of their own. This contract does not yet carry either: the police clearance stands for gate 4 until they are added, and adding them is a decision about every fixture on three platforms rather than an edit to this file.

gates.name: Assess
gates.happens: A structured interview and a skills test for the role — a clinical scenario, a road test, a dispensing procedure, an inspection of the premises.
gates.failRule: Below the threshold, the assessment may be taken once more. A second result below it ends the application.
gates.statement: You are assessed on the work itself: an interview and a test of the skills the role needs.

gates.name: Train
gates.happens: Protocol training, POPIA, safeguarding and the code of conduct, and a signed conduct agreement.
gates.failRule: Training that is not complete means the person is not activated, however far through it they are.
gates.statement: You complete MyThuso’s protocol, POPIA and safeguarding training, and sign the conduct agreement.

gates.name: Activate
gates.happens: The initial Trust Score is computed, the kit and identity lanyard are issued, and the person goes onto the roster on probation.
gates.failRule: Nobody goes live without a current Trust Score, and nobody is activated before gates 1 to 6 have passed.
gates.statement: Your first Trust Score is computed and you go onto the roster, on probation for your first visits.
gates.why: No check carries this gate either. It is what passing the other six means, computed from them on every read, so a number standing for it can never be stored and never go stale.

gateRules.lapse: A check past its renewal date holds the file at its gate until it is renewed. Nothing was decided against the person; the date passed.
gateRules.suspended: Suspended by a reviewer. Every gate already passed stays passed, and nothing is offered until the suspension is lifted.
gateRules.declined: This application was declined with a reason, and it stays declined until a reviewer decides it again.
gateRules.notActivated: Not activated. Every gate from 1 to 6 has to pass first, in its own right.
gateRules.why: The status is computed from the checks every time it is read and is never stored as a number. A gate number somebody wrote down is a claim about a person that stops being true the night a clearance lapses, without anything in the row changing.

selfActionRefusals.why: A party's own vetting record is theirs to read and to add their own documents to. Changing it is a reviewer's act, never the party's. These are the sentences a party is refused in when they try, and the gate, the vault and the store each hold the line independently: until September 2026 a nurse on the register could enrol herself as an admin and a suspended party could lift their own suspension, because acting on your own record was read as subject access whatever the act was.
selfActionRefusals.administrativeOnSelf: Your own vetting record is yours to read and to add your own documents to. Changing it — your role, a decision on one of your checks, a suspension — is done by a reviewer, never by the party it is about.
selfActionRefusals.enrol: Nobody enrols themselves or changes the role they are vetted in. A reviewer does that, and you are the party it is about.
selfActionRefusals.restore: Nobody lifts their own suspension. A reviewer does that, and you are the party it is about.
selfActionRefusals.alreadyEnrolled: This party is already on the register. Enrolling again does not change a role: a role change would be a decision nobody reviewed, and there is no route for one.
selfActionRefusals.readOwnThroughReviewerRoute: This route is a reviewer's, for reading somebody else's register entry. Your own standing is at /vetting/me, which tells you everything this would.

The clinical record opens for the visit being attended. It is not a directory a nurse may browse.
A protected category is released by the patient, entry by entry. It is never opened by a scope, however senior the nurse.
Nothing may be written into a patient's record by somebody the platform has not cleared to attend them.
